Your holdings: Your leveraged ETFs, SOXL (-32.39%) and SPAL (-28.23%), are in deep drawdowns and flagged "SELL." Remember, margin amplifies these losses, and leveraged products decay over time.

Bottom line: With significant losses in leveraged positions and trading on margin, risk management is paramount right now.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or exiting SOXL given its "SELL" status and -32.39% loss; leveraged ETFs decay and margin amplifies drops.
SPAL: Review SPAL's "SELL" status and -28.23% loss; its leveraged nature and fast moves demand attention.
No new buys today - hold and watch.
